clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan, Clockwerk Run lies between the Train Depot and the Hall of Gears. Toxic fallout and irradiated troggs fill the route into the fallen city.

Clockwerk Run runs from the outer Train Depot into Gnomeregan. Once, gnomish traffic and supplies moved through this corridor. High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered radioactive waste vented to stop the trogg invasion, turning the passage into a deadly trap. The blast and the fighting that followed brought parts of the hallway down. Toxic fumes and irradiated troggs now block the way to the upper Hall of Gears.
